nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) _balances storing token balance of every holder in ERC20.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) _allowances storing spending approvals.
Private uint256 _totalSupply holding the total number of minted tokens.
Private string _name of the TokenMintERC20Token, set once in the constructor.
Private string _symbol of the token, set once in the constructor.
Private uint8 _decimals number of decimals, set once in the constructor.
public view totalSupply() returning _totalSupply.
public view balanceOf(address account) returning _balances[account].
public transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) forwarding msg.sender to internal _transfer.
public view allowance(address owner, address spender) returning _allowances[owner][spender].
public approve(address spender, uint256 value) calling _approve(msg.sender, spender, value).
public transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) doing _transfer plus allowance sub/approve.
public increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) adding to caller allowance via SafeMath.add then _approve.
public decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) subtracting from caller allowance via SafeMath.sub then _approve.
internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) requiring non-zero addresses and updating _balances.
internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount) increasing _totalSupply and _balances[account] with SafeMath.add.
internal _burn(address account, uint256 value) reducing _totalSupply and _balances[account] with SafeMath.sub.
internal _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 value) writing _allowances[owner][spender].
internal _burnFrom(address account, uint256 amount) calling _burn then subtracting from caller allowance via _approve.

TokenMintERC20Token constructor(string name, string symbol, uint8 decimals, uint256 totalSupply, address payable feeReceiver, address tokenOwnerAddress) payable: sets metadata, mints supply and pays fee with feeReceiver.transfer(msg.value).
public burn(uint256 value) burning the caller's own tokens through _burn(msg.sender, value).
public view name() returning the _name string.
public view symbol() returning the _symbol string.
public view decimals() returning the _decimals value.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as token owner, spender and burner across transfer, approve, both allowance mutators, burn and transferFrom.
feeReceiver.transfer(msg.value): external ETH transfer to an arbitrary, caller-supplied address inside the payable constructor.

approve calls _approve to store the allowance.

_burnFrom calls _burn before adjusting the allowance.

constructor mints the whole supply through _mint.
caller-supplied feeReceiver address is the recipient of the ETH transfer, so an attacker-controlled contract is called from the constructor.
the payable constructor performs an external ETH transfer to an arbitrary address, enabling reentrant callback execution against a malicious feeReceiver.
